title: FUB-CSC PhD Program 2027
field: All disciplines at Freie Universität Berlin
about: FUB-CSC PhD Program 2027 at Freie Universität Berlin for doctoral candidates seeking China Scholarship Council support. Apply via the university's online portal from November 1, 2026 to January 15, 2027; accepted candidates then apply to the CSC, with research stays starting September/October 2027.
requirements: Master's degree; CV, motivation letter, research statement (2-3 pages), 1-2 recommendation letters
English (IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 95) or German (TestDaF 16 / DSH-2) language certificate

upskill.name: AI for Research & Information Synthesis
why: "research statement (2-3 pages)" → "Use AI to explore, organize, and structure information collected from multiple documents or professional sources."
"research statement (2-3 pages)" → "Transform complex information into research briefs, comparison matrices, executive summaries, and actionable recommendations."
